diagnosis: You have a credible reason to reconnect because the customer supplied real scheduling information and still faces a complex coordination decision. The strongest outreach helps them compare sequencing tradeoffs without asking them to restart the full sales conversation.

The maintenance-window dates are verified but no installation slot is reserved.

plays.title: Six-site sequencing map
plays.strategicAngle: Turn the new maintenance windows into a practical decision aid.
plays.whyNow: The customer can evaluate disruption before peak cooling demand narrows its options.
plays.valueToBring: Create a one-page draft that compares two phased sequences; label dates and assumptions for confirmation.
sequence: Email the draft map and name the assumptions.
Offer a 15-minute correction session four business days later.
Close the loop after one follow-up.
plays.rationale: Highly relevant and useful because it converts verified timing into decision help without manufacturing urgency.
